youtube.title: The Rocket to the Moon Was Built With a Secret | Operation Paperclip
youtube.description:
After WWII, the U.S. brought more than 1,600 German scientists to America in Operation Paperclip, including Wernher von Braun, a former SS officer whose V-2s were built with concentration-camp labor. He went on to lead the Saturn V program.

📂 Case File #009: Operation Paperclip

Sources: Annie Jacobsen, "Operation Paperclip" (2014); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Paperclip
Images: NASA and U.S. Army, public domain.
